description: One versioned DESIGN.md that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and every AGENTS.md agent reads before visual work, with a render-and-check quality floor and stale-piece status.
rules: Run `npx briefatto-board install` in the project root; it adds the skill and a pointer in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Adopt an existing site with `npx briefatto-board adopt .`, write DESIGN.md from the captures, then `npx briefatto-board freeze .`.
Read DESIGN.md before any visual work and run `npx briefatto-board check .` on every rendered piece before hand-over.
After a brand change, freeze again with a note and use `npx briefatto-board status` to list stale pieces.
